meta.name: cloudflare-email-service
meta.description: Implement or troubleshoot Cloudflare Email Sending and Email Routing integrations and their delivery configuration.

copy.tagline: 配置 Cloudflare 邮件发送与路由,并排查投递失败
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果邮件经 Cloudflare 投递异常,或要配置发送与路由集成
copy.tagline_en: Implement and troubleshoot Cloudflare email sending and routing integrations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're setting up Cloudflare email sending or routing and hitting delivery issues.

howto.what: 装好后,当你请 Claude 处理 Cloudflare 收发邮件事宜,它会先查官方最新说明,再引导你完成域名开通、发送配置或问题排查。
howto.when: 当你的请求涉及 Cloudflare 邮件发送、邮件路由或投递配置的实现与排查时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个 Cloudflare Worker 配上发送邮件功能。
say.note: Claude 会先核对域名并给出绑定配置。

say.text: 在 Cloudflare 上发邮件总进垃圾箱,帮我看看怎么处理。
say.note: Claude 会检查认证与内容方面的投递性设置。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you ask Claude to handle Cloudflare email sending/receiving tasks, it first retrieves official docs and its references, then guides you through domain onboarding, sending configuration, or troubleshooting.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to implement or troubleshoot Cloudflare Email Sending, Email Routing, or delivery configuration.

say_en.text: Help me add email sending to this Cloudflare Worker.
say_en.note: Claude checks the domain and gives binding config.

say_en.text: Use Cloudflare to receive emails sent to example.com and forward them to my inbox.
say_en.note: It provides the email handler code and address verification steps.

say_en.text: My Cloudflare emails keep going to spam; help me fix it.
say_en.note: Claude checks authentication and content deliverability settings.
